https://unpkg.com/maplibre-gl@5.6.2/

Photography style derived from VersaTiles Colorful (generated style metadata: CC0).
https://tiles.versatiles.org/assets/styles/colorful/style.json
https://github.com/versatiles-org/versatiles-style
Country labels omitted; uppercase text disabled.
Vector tiles: https://tiles.versatiles.org/tiles/osm/{z}/{x}/{y}
OpenStreetMap and ESA WorldCover attribution is retained on the map.
Public service documentation: https://versatiles.org/
